svg.title: 10-byte bzip2: Pseudorandom proxy sample (not a census)
svg.desc: Two histograms of compressed size divided by original size; lower is smaller. Whole stream and outer-framing-excluded payload. Counts do not represent all 2^80 inputs.
svg.text: Pseudorandom proxy sample (not a census) | n = 3,145,728
Payload retains internal block headers, CRC, tables and coding controls. Ratios above 100% mean expansion.
The exact period-divides-2 family is separate from the proxy sample; neither is the full 2^80-input distribution.
